provenance.source: data/raw/paysim/paysim.csv (HF mirror, MIT card; payments domain, EDA-ONLY)
provenance.method: streaming chunksize=200000, systematic stride=12 (offset rotates per chunk)

benchmark_mix_note: Our benchmark class mix is deliberate enrichment for detection evaluation, not natural prevalence: PaySim-scale natural fraud prevalence is ~0.1% (8,213/6,362,620 = 0.129% per manifest), at which a detector's alert burden and precision cannot be meaningfully benchmarked on a 10k-case set. Enriched mixes (e.g. ~10% like the MiPo slice) measure ranking quality (AUROC/AP) under controlled conditions; they must not be presented as production precision, and thresholds set on enriched data must be recalibrated to the deployment base rate before any operational use.
